title: User Management
description: Full members + invites + roles-admin surface ported from superspace, props-driven + RBAC-agnostic. <UserManagementPanel> tabs Members + Roles: member table (search / filter / sort, inline role dropdown, soft-remove), InviteDialog + PendingInvites (resend / cancel), and a RolesPanel to create / edit / delete custom roles via a permission matrix (system roles read-only). All permission-gated. You pass `roles` + `currentPerms` + the permission catalog (resolved from rbac-roles) + CRUD/invite/role callbacks; the slice imports no other slice's frontend. Plus a TeamsPanel (named user groups + add / remove members). Convex template ships um_members + um_invites + um_teams + um_team_members + member / invite / team endpoints (gated via rbac-roles' requirePermission); roles CRUD reuses rbac-roles' listRoles/upsertRole/removeRole. P1–P4a of the user-management epic — hierarchy + access matrix (P4b/c) next.

peers.reason: Roles + resolved permissions + the convex permission helpers (requirePermission, getActorPermissions).
Member identity (name/email/avatar) joined from the users table.
